title: Hexenwasser Söll Hohe Salve
highlights: Mehrfach international ausgezeichneter Berg-Erlebnispark rund um Wasser und Natur
Laengster Barfusspfad Oesterreichs ueber Gras, Rinde, Kieselsteine und Bachlaeufe
Ueber 60 feucht-froehliche Stationen mit Wasserradern, Klangschalen und Hexenwald
Bienenhaus mit Schau-Bienenstock und duftendem Imker-Erlebnis
kurzbeschreibung: Hexenwasser in Söll enchants families with over 60 adventure stations, a barefoot trail, water features, and a witches' forest on Hohe Salve.
beschreibung:
Wonder, Grasp, and Walk Barefoot

Hexenwasser Söll, located at the middle station of the Hohe Salve cable car, has been inspiring visitors of all ages for more than two decades. Under the motto Come and Wonder, the theme park invites guests to explore nature with all senses and above all with bare feet.

Watercourses, Witchcraft Crafts, and the World of Bees

Along the barefoot trail, hikers feel the variety of natural surfaces beneath their feet, while dam reservoirs and water canals invite everyone to splash and experiment to their heart's content. In rustic historic huts, authentic witches demonstrate age-old artisan crafts from churning butter to dipping candles.
